source.why_this_clip: A white marble fireplace with a mantel, mirror and candles, seen from the front in a parlour; the fireplace does not move, and from about 14 s the camera pans right so the fireplace slides left across the frame. There are no cuts in the clip; 14.0 to 18.0 is the stretch with the most camera motion while the whole fireplace stays in frame, before it leaves the left edge after about 18.5 s.
